column1: # SLAG-WD natural family: elemental mass fractions (ppm by mass) of the
# natural end-members a polluted white dwarf can be fed from
# element's atomic mass (A) and 50% condensation temperature (Tc50
# Sources (values transcribed at the ~0.05-0.1 dex level from the group
#   CM CO CV H L LL EH EL ... Wasson & Kallemeyn 1988 (Phil.Trans. A 325
#   water_ice ..... pure H2O; CHON_organics ... a comet-like refractory organic
# Zeros in the McDonough core model (lithophiles Mg Al Ca Ti Sc Sr Ba K Na Li Be)
# are written as 1e-4 ppm so that logarithms stay finite; a mixture with any
# silicate fraction sets the real floor.  The channel's sigma_sys = 0.15 dex
# of these compilations; docs/slag.md section 3 states this explicitly.
